representations.N: learned neural mean and eight learned neural features
representations.M: same neural architecture and initial weights; feature covariance explicitly zero, learned mean only
representations.PCA: frozen training-source GP mean and eight task-PCA features; base covariance calibrated on the same episodes

selection: minimum fixed source-validation conditional NLL; include untrained step 0 as a valid checkpoint; no development/confirmation metrics used
pairing: N/M share initial neural weights; all methods/seeds use deterministic paired episodes at the same step; seeds change initialization and training episodes, never the validation panel

source_prefixes.optimizer: exact same paid-only O GP/LogEI implementation as HPO transfer parent
source_prefixes.pool: the same at-most-256 previously acquired source records only
source_prefixes.teacher_models: fit only currently observed prefix labels; never use a full-task GP to choose search points
source_prefixes.validation_scope: 82 source-validation tasks have their own prefixes, used only for fixed evaluation/early stopping; none feed training gradients
source_prefixes.accounting: 688*40 = 27520 historical source-table accesses; zero new unique source labels and zero development/confirmation queries

episodes.training: uniform tasks within search space; exactly 8 uniform and 8 search-prefix contexts per update; disjoint context/query indices
episodes.validation: 8 fixed episodes per task and context size, 4 uniform and 4 search-prefix; identical for all three training seeds
episodes.normalization: context labels only, from frozen parent definition; no clipping of difficult query labels
metrics: normalized regret of selected point within the fixed 32-query panel
episodes.metric_limits: query-panel regret is a source validation diagnostic, not target BO regret or a real evaluation-efficiency claim

numerical_policy: positive parameter constraints from frozen source module; fail and preserve checkpoint on nonfinite loss/gradient, no silent episode dropping or variance edits
recovery: atomic checkpoints every validation boundary; model and optimizer saved; episode RNG derived from step, no ambiguous shared RNG state; repeated compute after a crash is separately reported
scope_limits: not a full Bayesian posterior over neural weights
selected validation scores are development evidence, not unbiased confirmation
after_training: report every space/seed and learning curve; N-M tests covariance increment, N-PCA tests nonlinear representation increment; freeze target integration and additional replacement controls only after source diagnostics
